semantics: Capability Profile (ADR 0021 decision 8) — a versioned, static snapshot of the host tool surface that the Claude Binding Table targets. Host churn is absorbed as a one-host data PR plus that host's conformance suite. Runtime detection/adaptation at creation time is forbidden (decision 8; the never-LLMs rule): this file is data, never probed.

subagentHandback.binding: specialist results are delivered back to the spawning conversation by the runtime

agentTeams.binding: opt-in only; never load-bearing (one team per session, fixed lead, no nested teams)

pluginLane.binding: compound plugin lane (.claude-plugin/plugin.json) per ADR 0018 decision 12

imageGeneration.binding: no image-generation tool exists on this host; asset creation happens outside the agent run

nameRules.subagentPrefixPolicy: strip the canonical `subagent-` prefix on this host (Plan 016 Step 4; zero collisions proven)

notes: Version floor provenance: SUBAGENT_HANDBACK_MIN in src/core/claude-capabilities.ts pins 2.1.271 as the SubagentHandback floor.

Tool-surface provenance: the union of ClaudeProjector.CLAUDE_DIALECT.toolVocabulary values and the FEATURE_LEDGER bindings in src/core/claude-projector.ts (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate, Cron tools, SendMessage, AskUserQuestion, WebSearch, WebFetch, Agent).
Conformance: this profile is asserted by tests/golden/claude-created/** (Plan 021 Step 5 Conformance Suite).
